name: IaC Security & Quality Benchmark Dataset
description: Standardized benchmark suite for evaluating IaC security tools, OPA policies, native tests, and zero-PII compliance.

test_cases.name: RDS Storage KMS Encryption
test_cases.description: Ensures RDS PostgreSQL databases are encrypted at rest with AWS KMS managed keys.

test_cases.name: Security Group Ingress Restrictions
test_cases.description: Verifies no security groups allow unrestricted inbound 0.0.0.0/0 SSH/RDP access.

test_cases.name: ALB Header Dropping Enforcement
test_cases.description: Checks that Application Load Balancers drop invalid HTTP header fields.

test_cases.name: Hardcoded Secret & Key Prevention
test_cases.description: Scans IaC HCL source files for hardcoded AWS secret keys, DB passwords, or API tokens.

test_cases.name: Native Terraform Test Coverage
test_cases.description: Validates presence and execution of native .tftest.hcl suites for all Terraform modules.

test_cases.name: Zero-PII Compliance in IaC Metadata
test_cases.description: Ensures no customer names, email addresses, or personal phone numbers exist in IaC metadata.

test_cases.name: CloudFront Minimum TLS 1.2 Constraint
test_cases.description: Enforces modern TLS version standards on CloudFront CDN distributions.

test_cases.name: VPC Flow Logs Enabled
test_cases.description: Ensures VPC Flow Logging is configured and active across all subnets.

test_cases.name: Cognito MFA & Password Policy
test_cases.description: Enforces strict password parameters and optional multi-factor authentication.

test_cases.name: ECS Fargate Encrypted Ephemeral Storage
test_cases.description: Validates that ECS Fargate container storage is encrypted with customer managed keys.
